title: Crypto asset manager CoinShares began trading on the Nasdaq Wednesday, marking its entry into US public markets after its $1.2B SPAC merger with Vine Hill (Naga Avan-Nomayo/The Block)
summary: Naga Avan-Nomayo / The Block: Crypto asset manager CoinShares began trading on the Nasdaq Wednesday, marking its entry into US public markets after its $1.2B SPAC merger with Vine Hill — Quick Take — CoinShares is set to begin trading on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol CSHR, following a $1.2 billion merger with special purpose acquisition company Vine Hill.
